neighbours.label: a change-of-amount participle in a passive 'was <verb> to/from N' (reduced, raised, widened, extended)
fire: After the budget cuts, the staff was reduced to four people.
In 2005 the speed limit on the highway was raised to 70 miles per hour.
The bridge was widened to carry two more lanes.
The deadline for applications was extended to the end of May.
The tax on fuel was lowered from eight to five percent.
The ship's crew was cut to a dozen sailors for the voyage.
The school day was lengthened by an extra hour.
The fine for littering was increased to two hundred dollars.
quiet: After the budget cuts, the staff was moved to another building.
In 2005 the speed limit on the highway was posted on new signs.
The bridge was painted green by the city workers.
The deadline for applications was announced at the end of May.
The tax on fuel was debated for eight weeks in parliament.
The ship's crew was welcomed by a dozen sailors on the dock.
The school day was described as long by the students.
The fine for littering was printed on a sign by the park.

notes: Card: top examples 'was raised from 14 to 18', 'was reduced to three', 'widened to', 延长 (extended); the output promotes become/reduce.
